Name: Shark Pet
Author: Blackpaw69
Description:
Hey! This mod adds a shark to Stardew Valley.


🔧[b]   Features[/b][list]
[*]Fully animated shark pet.
[*]Adopts like any other dog breed.
[*]Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6+
[*]Made with love and fins 🦈
[/list]💾 [b]Installation[/b][list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI
[*]Install Content Patcher
[*]Unzip this mod into your [code]Stardew Valley/Mods/[/code] folder
[*]Launch the game via SMAPI
[*]Choose the Shark in a new save or adopt him.

(Or install via vortex and skip step 3)

[/list][img]https://i.imgur.com/L0VVSPl.png[/img]﻿

🔮 [b]Future Plans[/b]

🗯 If the mod is well received, I plan to:

[list]
[*]Add [b]custom shark sounds[/b] (barks replaced with chirps, splashes, etc.)
[*]Maybe even a [b]matching water bowl[/b] or extra animation.
[/list]

Hope you enjoy it! I also plan on keeping this Mod updated.

Blackpaw

- Inspired by a certain lovable land-based shark — now pixelated and ready to nap on your farm.
